call_points.text: All three businesses are expected to deliver growth in FY27, with accelerated EBITDA and PAT growth; no numeric targets given.
CDMO RFP and order inflows improved from October 2025, helped by US biopharma funding up 75% YoY in H2FY26.
US$94Mn invested in FY26 across growth and maintenance projects.
Kenalog® acquired for US$35Mn upfront plus up to US$65Mn contingent; margins in line with CHG.
Sevoflurane US market share rose to 47% from 45% in Mar'24; ex-US growth muted by competition, to accelerate in FY27.
Injectable pain management supply constraints persist; company is working with its supplier to resolve them.
Quality track record maintained: 38 regulatory inspections including 3 USFDA cleared in FY26, zero OAI status.
Q4 included a ₹176 Cr impairment of intangible assets under development, written down in full.

guidance.statement: expect revenue growth of 19% to 20%, accompanied by meaningfully higher profitability.

operating_notes.text: US FDA inspection at Sellersville (USA) facility concluded with 3 observations and VAI recommendation.
US FDA issued an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) and successfully closed the inspection at the Digwal, Telangana manufacturing facility.
Gujarat Pollution Control Board granted permanent revocation of closure directions for the Dahej manufacturing site.
CDMO phase III molecules increased to 28, and 22 new customers added in H1FY27.

timeline.summary: Piramal Pharma reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue at ₹2,752 Cr with a net loss of ₹9 Cr after a ₹176 Cr impairment.
Vivek Valsaraj, Executive Director & CFO, shared audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results via conference call on 29 April 2026, with recording available on the company’s website.
US FDA concluded GMP inspection of Piramal Pharma's Sellersville facility with 3 VAI observations and no data integrity issues.
US FDA issued an Establishment Inspection Report and successfully closed the inspection at Piramal Pharma's Digwal facility.
Gujarat Pollution Control Board granted a permanent revocation of closure directions for Piramal Pharma's Dahej site.

Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,617.06 Cr (+28.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹5.58 Cr (against a loss of ₹99.22 Cr a year earlier) (includes ₹17.74 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹12.71 Cr).
On October 27, 2026, Piramal Pharma reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹2,617 Cr (+28% YoY) and PAT of ₹5 Cr, raising its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 19-20%.
